text: bunx wrangler@latest cache at $TMPDIR/bunx-501-wrangler@latest was missing esbuild, breaking deploys with MODULE_NOT_FOUND; rm -rf of the cache dir fixed it. Pinning wrangler as a project devDependency would prevent it.

share <symlinked-dir> uploaded zero files: find without -L doesn't follow the symlink, -type f rejects it, MAN empty, finalize wrote an empty manifest and the printed URL 404'd. Fixed with find -L plus an empty-manifest guard. Would have been caught instantly if the CLI failed loudly on zero files instead of printing the URL first.
